description: This file defines the OrganizationService class for managing organization entities, including creation, reading, updating, and validation logic, utilizing TypeORM for database interactions.

classes.name: OrganizationService
classes.description: Service class for handling organization-related operations such as creation, validation, retrieval, and updates.

methods.name: validateOrganizationId
methods.description: Validates if the provided organization ID is a valid UUID.

methods.name: readOrganizationById
methods.description: Fetches an organization by its ID using a QueryRunner.

methods.name: validateOrganizationName
methods.description: Validates the organization name, checking for invalid names and reserved names.

methods.name: readOrganizationByName
methods.description: Fetches an organization by its name using a QueryRunner.

methods.name: createNewOrganization
methods.description: Creates a new organization entity with generated ID and updatedBy set.

methods.name: saveOrganization
methods.description: Saves an organization entity to the database.

methods.name: createOrganization
methods.description: Creates a new organization, including user validation and transaction management.

methods.name: updateOrganization
methods.description: Updates an existing organization with validation and transaction handling.
